test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If,

‘B % D’ means ‘B is the sister of D’,

‘B & D’ means ‘B is the father of D’,

'B × D’ means ‘B is the husband of D’,

‘B # D’ means ‘B is the brother of D’,

‘B $ D’ means ‘B is the wife of D’,

‘B @ D’ means ‘B is the mother-in-law of D’,

then how is A related to K in the following expression?

A × B @ C $ D # E & K
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 &
 × 
 #

 Meaning
 Sister
 Father
 Husband
 Brother
 Wife
 Mother-in-law
 
 

 

Given:A × B @ C $ D # E & K

It means: A is the husband of B, B is the mother-in-law of C, C is the wife of D, D is the brother of E, and E is the father of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb39e09676ec049974e100c6a1b26ba59f634f4441d3ed0ed2eb4d4843097d13.png] 

So, A is the '**Grandfather**' of k.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
